name: bioc-intelligence
title: Bioconductor Intelligence marts
description: Usage, publication, citation and grant metrics for Bioconductor packages. Query in DuckDB: ATTACH 'https://seandavi.github.io/bioc-intelligence/data/bioc-intelligence.duckdb' AS bi (READ_ONLY).

resources.name: mart_ecosystem_downloads_yearly
resources.description: Downloads per year x repo x methodology era (2015 has a row per era).

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year.

fields.name: repo
fields.description: Repository: bioc (software), data-experiment, data-annotation or workflows.

fields.name: methodology_era
fields.description: Download-stats collection era: 'pre_2015_10' or 'modern'. Bioconductor changed its methodology in Oct 2015; do not add counts across eras.

fields.name: distinct_ips
fields.description: Distinct downloading IP addresses, the usage proxy (less gameable than downloads). Summed over months: an IP active in several months counts once per month.

fields.name: downloads
fields.description: Raw download count (kept for reference; prefer distinct_ips).

fields.name: n_packages_with_downloads
fields.description: Packages with at least one download that year.

resources.name: mart_grant_attribution
resources.description: One row per NIH grant acknowledged by a paper linked to a package.

fields.name: grant_id
fields.description: NIH core project number, e.g. U24CA289073.

fields.name: agency
fields.description: NIH Institute/Center code.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Grant title (NIH RePORTER).

fields.name: n_packages_supported
fields.description: Distinct packages whose linked paper acknowledges the grant.

fields.name: n_citing_works
fields.description: Distinct works citing those papers (0 until cited-by runs).

fields.name: package_names
fields.description: The supported packages.

resources.name: mart_package_directory
resources.description: One row per package: DESCRIPTION metadata from the repository VIEWS file.

fields.name: package_name
fields.description: Bioconductor package name.

fields.name: repo
fields.description: Repository: bioc (software), data-experiment, data-annotation or workflows.

fields.name: latest_release
fields.description: Newest Bioconductor release carrying the package.

fields.name: maintainer
fields.description: Maintainer name (no email).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Package title.

fields.name: description
fields.description: Package description.

fields.name: biocviews
fields.description: biocViews terms (Bioconductor's controlled vocabulary).

fields.name: url
fields.description: URLs from the DESCRIPTION URL field.

fields.name: bug_reports
fields.description: DESCRIPTION BugReports URL.

fields.name: source_doi
fields.description: The package's own DOI, when it has one.

fields.name: package_name
fields.description: Bioconductor package name.

fields.name: repo
fields.description: Repository: bioc (software), data-experiment, data-annotation or workflows.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Calendar year.

fields.name: month
fields.description: Month, 1-12.

fields.name: distinct_ips
fields.description: Distinct downloading IP addresses that month.

fields.name: downloads
fields.description: Raw download count (kept for reference; prefer distinct_ips).

fields.name: methodology_era
fields.description: Download-stats collection era: 'pre_2015_10' or 'modern'. Bioconductor changed its methodology in Oct 2015; do not add counts across eras.

resources.name: mart_package_funder
resources.description: One row per package x declared funder (the Authors@R fnd role).

fields.name: package_name
fields.description: Bioconductor package name.

fields.name: repo
fields.description: Repository: bioc (software), data-experiment, data-annotation or workflows.

fields.name: funder_id
fields.description: Normalized funder identifier.

fields.name: funder_name
fields.description: Normalized funder name.

fields.name: curated
fields.description: Funder name matched the curated alias list.

fields.name: declared_name
fields.description: Funder name as written in Authors@R.

fields.name: grant_number
fields.description: Grant number as declared, when present.

fields.name: grant_id
fields.description: NIH core project number when the declared grant matches RePORTER.

resources.name: mart_package_impact
resources.description: One row per package: downloads, linked publications, citations, RCR and grants.

fields.name: package_name
fields.description: Bioconductor package name.

fields.name: repo
fields.description: Repository: bioc (software), data-experiment, data-annotation or workflows.

fields.name: total_downloads
fields.description: All-time raw downloads (spans both methodology eras).

fields.name: total_distinct_ips
fields.description: All-time sum of monthly distinct IPs (spans both eras).

fields.name: downloads_trailing_12mo
fields.description: Raw downloads in the latest 12 months of stats.

fields.name: distinct_ips_trailing_12mo
fields.description: Sum of monthly distinct IPs in the latest 12 months of stats: the headline usage number.

fields.name: distinct_ips_prior_12mo
fields.description: Sum of monthly distinct IPs in the 12 months before the trailing window (for year-over-year change).

fields.name: usage_rank_in_repo
fields.description: Rank within repo by distinct_ips_trailing_12mo (1 = most used).

fields.name: n_primary_pubs
fields.description: Linked papers the package asks users to cite.

fields.name: total_citations
fields.description: Sum of OpenAlex citation counts across linked papers.

fields.name: n_citing_works
fields.description: Distinct works citing a linked paper (0 until the cited-by enrichment has run).

fields.name: median_rcr
fields.description: Median iCite Relative Citation Ratio across linked papers (RCR is a rate, so the median, never the sum).

fields.name: n_distinct_grants_citing
fields.description: Distinct NIH grants acknowledged by a linked paper (NIH RePORTER publication links).

resources.name: mart_package_person
resources.description: One row per package x person, from Authors@R (no emails).

fields.name: package_name
fields.description: Bioconductor package name.

fields.name: repo
fields.description: Repository: bioc (software), data-experiment, data-annotation or workflows.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: Person identifier (ORCID when declared, else a name key).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Person name.

fields.name: orcid
fields.description: ORCID iD, when declared.

fields.name: roles
fields.description: Authors@R roles: cre (maintainer), aut, ctb, fnd, ...

fields.name: is_maintainer
fields.description: Has the cre role.

fields.name: source
fields.description: Where the person came from (Authors@R or Maintainer).

resources.name: mart_package_work
resources.description: One row per package x linked publication, with the link's provenance.

fields.name: package_name
fields.description: Bioconductor package name.

fields.name: repo
fields.description: Repository: bioc (software), data-experiment, data-annotation or workflows.

fields.name: work_id
fields.description: Work identifier: PMID when known, else DOI (OpenAlex ID is an enrichment handle).

fields.name: doi
fields.description: DOI, bare and lower-case (no https://doi.org/ prefix).

fields.name: pmid
fields.description: PubMed ID.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Publication title.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Publication year.

fields.name: journal
fields.description: Journal or venue.

fields.name: citation_count
fields.description: OpenAlex citation count.

fields.name: icite_rcr
fields.description: Relative Citation Ratio (NIH iCite): field- and time-normalized citation rate; 1.0 = NIH-wide average.

fields.name: match_method
fields.description: How the link was made: doi (the package's own DOI), citation_file (CITATION / CITATION.cff), description_doi (a DOI in Description, sometimes a dependency's paper), title_search, manual.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: Link confidence, 0-1 (doi 1.0, citation_file 0.9, description_doi 0.8).

fields.name: role
fields.description: Role of the paper for the package, e.g. primary.

resources.name: mart_person
resources.description: One row per person: packages authored and maintained.

fields.name: person_id
fields.description: Person identifier (ORCID when declared, else a name key).

fields.name: name
fields.description: Person name.

fields.name: orcid
fields.description: ORCID iD, when declared.

fields.name: n_packages
fields.description: Packages the person appears on.

fields.name: n_maintained
fields.description: Packages where the person has the cre role.

fields.name: n_authored
fields.description: Packages where the person has the aut role.

fields.name: package_names
fields.description: The packages.

fields.name: bioc_release
fields.description: Bioconductor release, e.g. 3.23.

fields.name: n_packages
fields.description: Packages in the release.

fields.name: n_new_packages
fields.description: Packages first seen in the release (0 until version history lands).

fields.name: net_downloads
fields.description: Reserved: release-windowed downloads (NULL for now).

resources.name: mart_work
resources.description: One row per linked publication, with iCite RCR and citations.

fields.name: work_id
fields.description: Work identifier: PMID when known, else DOI (OpenAlex ID is an enrichment handle).

fields.name: pmid
fields.description: PubMed ID.

fields.name: doi
fields.description: DOI, bare and lower-case (no https://doi.org/ prefix).

fields.name: title
fields.description: Publication title.

fields.name: year
fields.description: Publication year.

fields.name: journal
fields.description: Journal or venue.

fields.name: icite_rcr
fields.description: Relative Citation Ratio (NIH iCite): field- and time-normalized citation rate; 1.0 = NIH-wide average.

fields.name: citation_count
fields.description: OpenAlex citation count.

views.name: package_pubs_confident
views.description: Package-paper links made by DOI or CITATION file only (drops description_doi and title_search). Use for grant reporting.
views.sql: SELECT * FROM mart_package_work WHERE match_method IN ('doi', 'citation_file')

views.name: downloads_modern_era
views.description: Yearly downloads per repo, modern collection methodology only (Oct 2015 on).

views.name: ecosystem_yearly
views.description: Downloads per year summed across repos, one row per methodology era (never mix eras).
views.sql: SELECT year, methodology_era, SUM(distinct_ips) AS distinct_ips, SUM(downloads) AS downloads, SUM(n_packages_with_downloads) AS n_packages_with_downloads FROM mart_ecosystem_downloads_yearly GROUP BY year, methodology_era ORDER BY year, methodology_era

views.name: package_impact_ranked
views.description: package_impact ordered by rank within repo on trailing-12-month distinct IPs.
views.sql: SELECT * FROM mart_package_impact ORDER BY repo, usage_rank_in_repo
